# Command line

Everything is one command, `ppe-guard`, with subcommands. Run `ppe-guard <command> --help` for the same text.

```text
usage: ppe-guard [-h] [--version]
                 {serve,password,predict,train,val,export,dataset,weights,doctor} ...

PPE compliance monitoring for construction sites.

positional arguments:
  {serve,password,predict,train,val,export,dataset,weights,doctor}
    serve               run the web dashboard
    password            protect the dashboard with a password, or create an API token
    predict             check images, a folder, a video, a webcam or a stream
    train               fine-tune a YOLO model on the PPE dataset
    val                 evaluate weights on the validation or test split
    export              export weights to ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, CoreML, TFLite...
    dataset             dataset tools
    weights             list or download the trained PPE models
    doctor              check Python, GPU, models and dataset

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
```

## `serve`

```text
usage: ppe-guard serve [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--data-dir DATA_DIR]
                       [--models-dir MODELS_DIR] [--no-autostart]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --host HOST
  --port PORT
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   where settings, the database and snapshots live (default ./data)
  --models-dir MODELS_DIR
                        where model weights are stored (default ./models)
  --no-autostart        don't start cameras marked autostart
```

## `password`

```text
usage: ppe-guard password [-h] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--stdin] {set,clear,token,status}

positional arguments:
  {set,clear,token,status}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   the server's data directory (default ./data)
  --stdin               read the new password from standard input
```

## `predict`

```text
usage: ppe-guard predict [-h] [--weights WEIGHTS] [--conf CONF] [--imgsz IMGSZ] [--device DEVICE]
                         [--require REQUIRE] [--delay DELAY] [--strict] [--show] [--save DIR]
                         [--fail-on-violation]
                         source

positional arguments:
  source               image, folder, video file, webcam index (0) or rtsp/http URL

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --weights WEIGHTS
  --conf CONF
  --imgsz IMGSZ
  --device DEVICE
  --require REQUIRE    comma list of helmet,vest,mask
  --delay DELAY        seconds before a video violation opens
  --strict             unseen required items count as missing
  --show               open a preview window
  --save DIR           write annotated images/video to DIR
  --fail-on-violation  exit with status 1 if any violation
```

## `train`

```text
usage: ppe-guard train [-h] [--model MODEL] [--data DATA] [--epochs EPOCHS] [--batch BATCH]
                       [--imgsz IMGSZ] [--patience PATIENCE] [--seed SEED] [--device DEVICE]
                       [--workers WORKERS] [--fraction FRACTION] [--project PROJECT] [--name NAME]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL        base weights, e.g. yolo26s.pt, yolo11s.pt, yolov8s.pt
  --data DATA          dataset yaml (default training/data.yaml)
  --epochs EPOCHS
  --batch BATCH
  --imgsz IMGSZ
  --patience PATIENCE
  --seed SEED
  --device DEVICE
  --workers WORKERS
  --fraction FRACTION  share of training images to use (quick tests)
  --project PROJECT
  --name NAME
```

```text
options:

  --data DATA

  --imgsz IMGSZ
  --batch BATCH
  --device DEVICE
```

## `dataset`

```text

positional arguments:

```
